description: Fictional vendor catalog for the Account Intelligence Engine. Meridian Experience Cloud does not exist. Solutions map to the objective layer by industry_id and objective_id so the scoring layer can match stated objectives to vendor capabilities. Proof points are illustrative.

vendor.name: Meridian Experience Cloud
vendor.positioning: A single foundation for customer data, journey orchestration, analytics, content, governance, and conversational experience. Meridian is fictional and exists only to demonstrate the engine.

solutions.name: Meridian Profile
solutions.what_it_does: Unifies customer data into a real-time, single profile that every channel can act on, with a federated option that queries the customer's own warehouse rather than copying data out of it.
capabilities: Identity resolution across web, app, email, and call center
Federated queries against the customer's data warehouse
proof_points: Illustrative: unified profiles across five channels in a single activation layer
differentiators: Federated option keeps regulated data in place
Real-time rather than batch profile updates

solutions.name: Meridian Journeys
solutions.what_it_does: Designs and triggers personalized journeys across channels in real time, from onboarding to retention, based on live customer behavior.
proof_points: Illustrative: onboarding journey lifted completed sign-ups versus a static flow in an internal test
differentiators: Journeys triggered on live behavior, not overnight segments

solutions.name: Meridian Analytics
solutions.what_it_does: Analyzes the full customer journey across channels on one data set, so teams can follow a single customer from web to app to call center in one analysis.
proof_points: Illustrative: single cross-channel view replacing three disconnected reporting tools
differentiators: Built-in holdouts make incremental lift measurable rather than assumed

solutions.name: Meridian Content Studio
solutions.what_it_does: Speeds compliant content and campaign production with commercially safe generative AI, shared review workflows, and reusable brand-governed assets.
capabilities: Commercially safe generative AI for content
proof_points: Illustrative: shorter brief-to-launch time on campaign content in an internal benchmark
differentiators: Generative AI trained for commercial safety
Compliance review built into the production path

solutions.name: Meridian Govern
solutions.what_it_does: Enforces data-use and consent rules at the field level across every activation, with an audit trail, so teams can honor obligations consistently across channels.
proof_points: Illustrative: field-level consent enforcement applied consistently across activation channels
differentiators: Enforcement at the point of activation, not just at collection
solutions.guardrail: Supports data-use and consent obligations. Does not by itself make an organization compliant; regulated advice stays human-accountable.

solutions.name: Meridian Concierge
solutions.what_it_does: Delivers brand-governed conversational experiences that handle high-volume self-service while staying inside defined guardrails.
proof_points: Illustrative: common self-service tasks handled within guardrails, with human handoff on exceptions
differentiators: Guardrails and brand governance applied to every response
solutions.guardrail: Conversational guidance in regulated contexts stays inside policy and hands off to a human where accountability is required.
